location_description: East Stroudsburg is a borough in Monroe County, Pennsylvania, United States. It is located in the Poconos region of the state.  Originally known as "Dansbury", East Stroudsburg was renamed for geographic reasons when the Delaware, Lackawanna, and Western Railroad opened a station in town.
